item.description: Labor's plan to deliberately oversupply the domestic gas market is set to pass parliament, with the Coalition saying it will not oppose the bill.

item.title: ABC News: Gosling case link denied, as NT Administrator racks up travel bill
item.description: The NT chief minister claims "no involvement whatsoever" in the case against Labor MP Luke Gosling, as the NT Administrator racks up a $10k a day bill in the UK.

item.title: ABC News: Returning Matildas star Cooney-Cross wants to make late mum 'proud'
item.description: Kyra Cooney-Cross is preparing for her first Matildas' appearances since her mother's death in July, and she's ready to be back in the spotlight.

item.title: ABC News: Curtains have closed on parliament for the year. Who walks away a winner?
item.description: The government cleared almost everything it wanted off the legislative decks this week, but there were still plenty of surprises and shocks in store.

item.title: ABC News: Scale of voyeur doctor's offending 'beggars belief', Melbourne court told
item.description: Disgraced trainee surgeon Ryan Cho, who secretly filmed hundreds of colleagues in hospital toilets, could receive a reduced jail term because prosecutors combined his charges to streamline the case.

item.title: ABC News: Dramatic audio released of teen's arrest after electric motorbike death
item.description: A teenager accused of killing a Perth nurse after hitting her with an electric motorbike he was riding is heard telling police he only increased his speed because he was being chased by police.

item.title: ABC News: Boy who died sleeping in bin subject of 29 child abuse reports, court hears
item.description: A coronial inquest hears that dozens of abuse notifications were made involving the 13-year-old in the years leading up to his death after sleeping rough in a skip bin.

item.title: ABC News: Lamarre-Condon staying in secretive prison unit as police review resumes
item.description: Beau Lamarre-Condon's murder trial may be over but he now faces a long prison sentence and renewed scrutiny of his actions as a NSW Police officer.

item.title: ABC News: Coalition unveils plans to privatise sewerage system if elected
item.description: Opposition Leader Jess Wilson will partly-privatise Melbourne's sewerage network, cut and delay level crossing removals, and cancel expanding free kindergarten if elected on Saturday.

item.title: ABC News: Why the US Army detonated tonnes of toxic chemical near farmland
item.description: The US Army destroyed America's entire stockpile of a toxic bomb-making material in a controlled explosion in Iowa on Wednesday. Here's why.

item.title: ABC News: Canberra motorcyclist dies after colliding with pole
item.description: A 40-year-old man has died after his motorcycle left the road and hit a pole in Canberra's south this afternoon.

item.title: ABC News: Cane toad reported in Adelaide as authorities appeal for public lookout
item.description: South Australia's Department of Primary Industries and Regions has issued a public alert after receiving a report about a cane sighting in Adelaide's west.
